field.name: vi_bona_fide_resident
field.comment: True if taxpayer meets bona fide resident test for USVI

field.name: vi_days_present
field.comment: Number of days present in USVI during tax year (183+ required)

field.name: vi_has_tax_home
field.comment: True if taxpayer has tax home in USVI

field.name: vi_closer_connection
field.comment: True if taxpayer has closer connection to VI than US

field.name: vi_has_edc_benefits
field.comment: True if taxpayer qualifies for EDC tax benefits

field.name: vi_edc_reduction_rate
field.comment: EDC tax reduction rate (up to 90% reduction on qualified income)

field.name: vi_requires_form_8689
field.comment: True if taxpayer must file Form 8689 (income allocation)

field.name: vi_files_with_irb
field.comment: True if taxpayer files with VI Bureau of Internal Revenue

field.name: vi_files_with_irs
field.comment: True if taxpayer also files with IRS (partial-year or non-resident)

field.name: vi_uses_federal_rates
field.comment: USVI uses mirror code (same as federal tax code)

field.name: vi_income_tax
field.comment: Calculated USVI income tax liability (mirrors federal)

field.name: vi_income_tax_after_edc
field.comment: USVI tax after EDC benefits applied
